payload.title: Text-classification use case links to /stdlib/classify/ (404) and to GitHub blob paths that 404
payload.description:
**Problem**
https://tactus.anth.us/use-cases/text-classification/ links to /stdlib/classify/ and to GitHub blob paths that do not exist.

**Evidence**
Re-checked 2026-10-20: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L https://tactus.anth.us/stdlib/classify/` returns 404 (the use-case page itself returns 200). The GitHub blob 404s are from the audit crawl.

**Fix**
Point the links at the real stdlib docs page and at current file paths in the Tactus repo.

**How to verify**
Every link on the use-case page returns 200 (link checker over the crawl).

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
